hook: FMG interns end strike, back on duty in *all districts*
hook_b: FMG interns end strike, back on duty in *all districts*
tldr: FMG interns at Telangana government medical colleges announced an unconditional withdrawal of their strike on Friday and resumed internship duties.

beats.what: A delegation then met Health Minister Damodar Raja Narasimha with their stipend representations.
beats.why: The interns said they called off the protest based on trust in the government's assurances.
beats.care: The minister urged interns to focus on hospital duties and patient care while the administration works on a resolution.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Interns have returned to compulsory rotatory internship duties with immediate effect.

cards.q: FMG interns went back on assurances. What next?

qs: How much would raising FMG stipends cost the state?
Will interns get arrears for the protest period?

facts.t: The protest had reached its *34th day* on Nov 10, with a relay hunger strike.

viz.verdict: The gap behind the strike, per interns' earlier protest

learn.t: FMG = Foreign Medical Graduate, an Indian who studied medicine abroad.

watch: Whether the state announces a stipend revision for FMG interns.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana FMG interns call off strike following government assurances

fact: Foreign medical graduate interns end strike, resume duty in *all* districts
twist: The Health Minister only assured that a stipend hike would be *positively examined*.
